mapper.select: SELECT id::text,login_name,secret_digest,expires_at,created_by::text,consumed_by::text,invalidated FROM iam_invitation WHERE secret_digest=#{digest} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id::text,login_name,secret_digest,expires_at,created_by::text,consumed_by::text,invalidated FROM iam_invitation WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_invitation(id,login_name,secret_digest,expires_at,created_by) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS uuid),#{loginName},#{secretDigest},#{expiresAt},CAST(#{createdBy} AS uuid))
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_invitation SET consumed_by=CAST(#{consumedBy} AS uuid),invalidated=#{invalidated} WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND consumed_by IS NULL AND NOT invalidated
